items.title: Trading Systems Engineer (Kalshi Trading LLC)
items.location_text: New York, New York, United States
items.description: Kalshi is defining a new category Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more. We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position. Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet. Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets. Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling . Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets. Role Roadmap Kalshi Trading is an affiliated trading entity that operates across all different categories on Kalshi. We are looking for backend engineers who can build and maintain the infrastructure underlying our trading operations. The ideal candidate will have the following attributes: At least 3 years of professional experience as a backend engineer Experience directly building trading systems including order management Experience building robust high performance event-driven systems and APIs Experience writing concurrent code Very comfortable with relational databases (e.g. Postgres) Familiarity with the AWS stack (especially RDS and ECS) Proficiency in one of: Golang, Rust, C++ In addition to the above, the ideal candidate will also potentially have one or more of these attributes: Familiarity with stream processing (Kafka) Familiarity with frontend development Familiarity with machine learning, neural networks, or generative AI including LLMs Experience trading on Kalshi or other prediction markets The rest of what the role looks like is up to you - a big part of our approach is that you get to chart your path as we grow and evolve. You will have a lot of influence in shaping what both your role and the activity of Kalshi Trading look like as we grow. There's a lot of green field to conquer, we trust that you'll make a lot of it your own. NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure: Salary Range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This salary range is based on the current available market data and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but a broad range of experience is represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to discuss further. Our Culture Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets. Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1. Commitment to Equal Opportunity Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

items.description: This is not a typical overnight job. You are not stocking shelves. You are not sitting at a front desk watching the clock. You are not working on a smoky casino floor. You’ll host live online casino games on camera inside a modern professional studio at 11pm, 1am, or 3am while online players tune in live. Think: live hosting, customer service, and a broadcast studio environment, all during the overnight shift. You don’t need casino or dealer experience. That’s what paid training is for. No casino or dealer experience required. We will train you. Requirements Must be 21 years of age or older Must pass required background checks Must be able to obtain and maintain a valid Pennsylvania gaming license Must be able to work overnight shifts, weekends, and holidays Must wear the assigned uniform and maintain professional appearance standards Strong communication skills and a positive, professional attitude Responsible, dedicated, and dependable

items.title: Platform Engineering Tech Lead, Cloud - Infra
items.description: As a Platform Engineering Tech Lead , you will provide hands-on technical leadership for a team responsible for building and operating cloud and platform capabilities that power our applications and customer experiences. Your primary focus will be AWS, cloud, edge and platform technologies , while working closely with other Platform Engineering specialists, including our Kubernetes Tech Lead. You will help shape technical solutions, work with Architects, build POCs, review implementations and get hands-on with the technology when needed. This is a role for someone who enjoys being close to the technology while also helping engineers solve complex problems, raising engineering standards and driving the platform forward. A taster of what you will be involved with Provide hands-on technical leadership – Shape technical solutions with Architects, define technical approaches, conduct POCs and drive engineering standards across cloud, edge and platform technologies. Build and enable the team – Coach and unblock engineers, share knowledge and promote collaboration so that knowledge is distributed and no single person becomes a point of failure. Support technical assessments and code reviews. Drive reliability and operational excellence – Lead technical incident response and RCA, ensuring solutions are production-ready, resilient and have appropriate rollback strategies. Observability as a first-class concern – including logs, metrics, traces and SLOs. Drive cloud and platform evolution – Build and improve AWS-based capabilities through automation, Infrastructure as Code and modern platform engineering practices, while identifying opportunities for innovation and modernisation. Collaborate across Platform Engineering – Work closely with Kubernetes, Observability, Delivery, Security and Architecture teams to ensure our platform operates as a cohesive ecosystem. What we’re looking for Strong experience in AWS and cloud engineering in production environments. Experience with AWS edge and networking technologies, such as CloudFront, Route 53, WAF, load balancing, CDN and edge computing. Good working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerised platforms and the ability to work effectively alongside Kubernetes specialists. Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation, particularly Terraform and Ansible, along with modern CI/CD practices. Comfortable remaining hands-on with code, infrastructure, configuration and troubleshooting. Experience with code reviews, technical design discussions and POCs. Strong understanding of observability and reliability, including logs, metrics, traces and SLOs. Experience mentoring engineers and providing technical leadership without relying on formal management authority. Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain technical decisions, trade-offs and risks. Who We Are Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers! Product Development at Betsson Group Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 6 Tech Hubs – Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn, Malaga and Athens. With around 1,000 strong professionals, the Product Development organisation is spear-headed by our CTO-CPO with all our talented Area Teams working together. Challenge accepted? items.title: Manager, Sales Development - EMEA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Sales Development Manager for EMEA at Anthropic, you will lead and scale our business development function across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. You will build and manage a team of 6-8 BDRs primarily in Dublin. This role requires exceptional agility, cultural fluency across diverse European markets, and the ability to develop segment-specific strategies while navigating complex regulatory environments and regional nuances. You will be instrumental in establishing Anthropic's regional presence and building the foundation for long-term growth in EMEA. Key Responsibilities Build, lead, and scale a team of BDRs across EMEA markets including SEU, NEU, and DACH. Develop and execute region-specific prospecting strategies that account for local market dynamics, cultural nuances, and competitive landscapes across diverse European markets Support all sales segments (Startups, Commercial, Enterprise) with agility to shift resources based on regional opportunities Partner with regional AEs and sales leadership to align pipeline generation with territory plans and revenue targets Establish KPIs and tracking mechanisms that account for regional differences while maintaining global consistency Create localized training programs and enablement materials that resonate with diverse European business cultures Build and maintain relationships with regional marketing teams to optimize lead quality and campaign effectiveness Own regional Pipeline Reviews with sales leadership covering market-specific insights and growth opportunities Navigate complex hiring and employment regulations across multiple European countries, partnering with HR and Legal Coach and develop BDRs on region-specific prospecting techniques and career progression Qualifications 3-6 years of experience managing sales development or inside sales teams in EMEA Proven track record of growing and scaling teams across multiple European countries/offices Experience managing distributed teams across different time zones and cultures within EMEA Strong understanding of business practices, sales cycles, and decision-making processes in key EMEA markets Experience adapting global sales processes for European markets while maintaining consistency Deep understanding of GDPR, EU AI Act, and other European regulatory requirements affecting enterprise sales Strong analytical skills with ability to identify and act on regional market opportunities Experience with Salesforce and sales technology stack Excellent communication skills with ability to operate effectively across European cultures Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience Preferred Experience Experience at US-headquartered technology companies expanding in EMEA Background in AI/ML, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms Track record of building BDR/SDR functions from scratch in new European markets Experience managing both velocity (Startup/Commercial) and strategic (Enterprise) sales motions Fluency in German, French, Spanish or other major European languages Network of talent for BDR hiring across EMEA markets The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: €210.000 — €260.000 EUR Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

While you won't be expected to code day-to-day, you should be comfortable reviewing technical changes, challenging engineering decisions, understanding technical risks and participating in production incidents. You will also be accountable for the overall performance, stability and operational health of the domain, ensuring platform services meet agreed SLAs/SLOs, reducing incidents and continuously improving the experience for the engineering teams that depend on them. Drive technical excellence – Partner with Tech Leads and Architects to challenge technical decisions, manage risks and ensure platform solutions are reliable, secure and maintainable. Own platform performance and stability – Monitor SLAs/SLOs, service health and engineering metrics, driving continuous improvement, reducing incidents and improving reliability. Lead operational excellence – Ensure operational readiness, observability, incident management and effective RCA, acting as an escalation point for major incidents and ensuring preventative actions are delivered. Partner across the organisation – Work with application engineering teams, Architects and Engineering Leaders to understand needs, manage expectations, remove blockers and continuously improve platform capabilities and ways of working. Strong roadmap, prioritisation and delivery management skills, with accountability for quality and timelines. Experience working with Tech Leads, Architects, Product and engineering stakeholders. Good understanding of platform engineering, cloud, CI/CD, automation and Infrastructure as Code. Strong understanding of observability, reliability and production operations. Experience managing SLAs/SLOs, service performance and operational metrics, with a focus on improving stability and reducing incidents. Strong communication, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic and outcome-focused approach. Nice to have Experience managing teams responsible for CI/CD, developer platforms, engineering tooling or software delivery platforms. Experience managing Observability, SRE or Platform Reliability teams. Experience with AWS or other major cloud platforms. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. This role combines technical execution with leadership, ensuring our systems work effectively for developers and users. items.title: Staff Backend Engineer, Services
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE The exchange is the core of what Polymarket does. Every trade, every order, every market resolution runs through the systems this team owns. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Services team, you'll be working directly on that infrastructure, building and scaling the backend that processes real money, in real time, at meaningful volume. The work is technical, high-stakes, and unambiguous in its consequences. This is an individual contributor role with high autonomy and high ownership. You'll work alongside a small group of senior engineers who care deeply about correctness and performance. There's no heavy process here, no committees, no long approval chains. You'll be expected to identify problems, propose solutions, and ship them. The mandate is simple: keep the exchange fast, correct, and available as Polymarket continues to scale. If you've spent your career building systems where performance actually matters, where a bug in production has real consequences, this is the kind of problem you've been waiting to work on. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design and implement low-latency backend services that power Polymarket's core exchange, primarily in Go, with Python or Java where appropriate. - Profile and tune systems across the full stack, identifying bottlenecks in latency, throughput, and memory usage before they become production problems. - Build and maintain event-driven data pipelines and APIs using streaming platforms like Kafka or Pulsar, ensuring data moves reliably and quickly across the exchange. - Own production reliability for the systems you build, including diagnosing live incidents, writing postmortems, and shipping fixes that prevent recurrence. - Work directly with engineers across product, infrastructure, and data to integrate exchange services tightly with the broader platform. - Contribute to architectural decisions on distributed systems design, with a focus on failure modes, graceful degradation, and recovery under partial outages. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 7+ years of professional backend development experience, with strong proficiency in Go, Python, or Java. Go experience is a significant advantage. - Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and memory management, with a track record of applying that knowledge to real production systems. - Experience building and debugging high-throughput, low-latency systems on Linux end-to-end, from design through to production operation. - Strong instincts for correctness, especially in systems where failures have financial consequences. You write defensively, think about edge cases early, and treat bugs in prod as a serious matter. - Comfortable working independently in a high-autonomy environment. You identify what needs to be done and do it without waiting to be unblocked. - (Plus) Experience in trading systems, high-frequency trading, gaming, telecom, or any domain where latency is a hard constraint, not a stretch goal. - (Plus) Production experience with Kafka, Pulsar, or similar streaming platforms at meaningful scale. - (Plus) Familiarity with gRPC, Protobuf, or ZeroMQ. - (Plus) Experience deploying and operating services in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, using containers and modern deployment tooling. BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: HPC Infrastructure Engineer - GPU Clusters
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE Every model we train runs on infrastructure this role owns. We operate NVIDIA GPU clusters across bare metal and rented capacity, and we're looking for an engineer to join our small research infrastructure team and make that compute fast, reliable, and boring - in the best sense. When the clusters just work, research moves faster. Your impact is measured directly in training throughput and researcher velocity. This is a builder-operator role with real breadth: one week you're writing automation that eliminates a whole class of manual work, the next you're benchmarking a new provider's InfiniBand fabric or on-site bringing new hardware online. You'll have unusual scope and autonomy - we're a lean team where decisions are made by the people closest to the problem. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING - Operate and improve our GPU fleet end to end: provisioning, scheduling, monitoring, upgrades, capacity planning - Build automation that keeps the fleet healthy without human intervention — node health checks, automated draining and remediation, burn-in pipelines for new capacity - Own the stack beneath the training code: OS images, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, NCCL, high-speed networking (InfiniBand/RoCE) - Run and tune job scheduling (Slurm or similar) so researchers get compute fairly and fast - Build and maintain high-performance storage for datasets and checkpoints - Hunt down performance problems: stragglers, degraded links, thermal issues, flaky GPUs — and fix the class of problem, not just the instance - Evaluate rented GPU capacity: benchmark it, validate it, hold providers to their SLAs - Hands-on hardware work when it's needed: racking, cabling, diagnostics, coordinating with datacenter staff and vendors - Keep clusters secure by default: access control, network isolation, secrets REQUIREMENTS - Have run large-scale Linux server or GPU environments in production and enjoy both building and operating - Know the NVIDIA stack well — drivers, CUDA, NCCL, DCGM — or have deep systems experience and learn hardware stacks fast - Are comfortable with bare-metal environments, server hardware, and high-speed networking - Write solid automation in Python and/or Bash, with IaC tools like Ansible or Terraform - Are happy digging into noisy data (metrics, logs, PromQL) to find what's actually wrong - Like owning real scope end to end and being the person others rely on - Don't consider any task above or beneath you — datacenter trips included NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting ML training workloads from the infra side (distributed training failure modes, checkpointing patterns) - Experience evaluating and working with GPU cloud providers - Parallel filesystems (WEKA, VAST, etc) or large-scale object storage - BMC/IPMI/Redfish automation, PXE provisioning at scale - Power and cooling awareness for dense GPU deployments LOCATION This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote #HPC-Infrastructure-Engineer-GPU-Clusters We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Customer Operations Excellence Manager F/M
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME 🎮 As the Customer Operations Excellence Manager, you are responsible for leading the Quality and Training functions across Customer Operations, ensuring our people and customer interactions consistently meet high standards and contribute to an exceptional customer experience You will own the Customer Operations quality and capability framework, combining quality assurance, calibration, customer insight, onboarding, continuous learning and knowledge management. Working closely with Customer Service Operations, Planning, Trust & Safety, Product and Technology, you will turn customer and operational insights into practical improvements that strengthen performance, compliance and customer outcomes YOUR RO LE WITHIN BETCLIC 🔥 In this role, your main missions will be: Lead, coach and develop the Quality and Training teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, learning and continuous improvement. Own and continuously evolve the Customer Operations Quality Assurance framework, ensuring evaluation standards remain aligned with business objectives, customer expectations and regulatory requirements Define, maintain and monitor quality standards, scorecards, KPIs, calibration routines and governance processes across Customer Operations. Lead calibration sessions to ensure consistent quality assessments across evaluators, Team Leaders and operational stakeholders. Drive the adoption of AI-powered quality monitoring, speech and text analytics, digital learning tools and automation to increase quality coverage and operational insight. Analyse customer interactions, quality results and operational performance data to identify trends, root causes, capability gaps and improvement opportunities. Deliver actionable Voice of the Customer insights that support improvements across Customer Operations, Product, Technology and other business functions. Partner closely with the Customer Service Operations Manager to improve service quality, operational consistency, employee capability and customer satisfaction. Own the Customer Operations learning approach, ensuring onboarding, continuous learning and development activities support operational priorities and business needs. Design, coordinate and continuously improve onboarding programmes that enable new employees to become confident and productive as quickly as possible. items.title: Manager, Applied AI Architects
items.description: About the Team The Applied AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. About the Role As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Tokyo, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers across Japan. Your team will act as the “CTO of the book of business,” partnering with customer executives and technical teams from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. You will set the operating model for how Applied AI Architects own technical account plans across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In close partnership with Sales leadership and Account Directors, you will help prioritize customer portfolios, allocate technical resources, and ensure business priorities translate into focused use cases, credible architectures, actionable adoption roadmaps, and durable customer value and growth. You will remain accountable for the team's technical outcomes while developing its people and bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, research, and partners. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between Japan strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching. In this role, you will: - Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Applied AI Architects, creating an environment of technical excellence, sound judgment, continuous learning, accountability, and strong customer stewardship. - Define and continuously refine the strategy and operating model for Applied AI Architecture across Japan, aligning company priorities with the evolving needs of strategic customers and the regional go-to-market. - Partner with Sales leadership and Account Directors to prioritize accounts and opportunities, allocate technical resources effectively, and establish clear technical strategies for the region's most consequential engagements. - Ensure Applied AI Architects serve as the primary technical advisors for their portfolios, owning technical account plans, technical milestones, adoption priorities, account health, and expansion opportunities. - Lead complex, multi-threaded customer journeys that connect executive vision and business outcomes with use-case qualification, solution evaluation, enterprise governance, and a credible path to production. - Coach the team on Applied AI architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, reliability, and deployment. - Build trusted relationships with C-suite and board-level stakeholders, as well as senior AI, technology, data, security, and engineering leaders, serving as an executive technical sponsor when needed. - Mobilize Deployment Engineering, implementation, enablement, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Legal, Privacy, partners, and other specialists to remove blockers and deliver a cohesive customer experience. - Establish a rigorous view of portfolio health, including technical wins, qualified use cases, production readiness, adoption, usage, risks, measurable customer impact, and the technical contribution to growth. - Translate patterns from the field into actionable feedback for Product, Engineering, Research, and go-to-market teams, while developing reusable architecture guidance and customer practices. - Foster a culture that balances ambitious customer outcomes with responsible AI deployment, clear ownership, thoughtful prioritization, and effective specialist handoffs. You might thrive in this role if you: - Possess deep technical acumen in modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, platform technologies, software and cloud architecture, APIs, data integration, identity, security, privacy, evaluation, and enterprise deployment. - Bring 10+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical consulting, including work with large and complex enterprises. - Have 4+ years of people-management experience hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing customer-facing technical teams. - Have guided enterprise organizations from technical discovery and evaluation through production adoption, healthy usage, and measurable business impact. - Demonstrate outstanding executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build credibility with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, boards, business leaders, and hands-on engineers. - Can lead a complex portfolio, make thoughtful resource-allocation decisions, and balance regional strategy with hands-on support for critical customer engagements. - Exercise strong architectural judgment, including knowing when to go deep personally, when to coach the team, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership. - Build strong partnerships across Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Deployment, Customer Engagement, Security, Legal, Privacy, and external partner ecosystems. - Are comfortable leading across Japan from Tokyo and adapting your approach to different industries, cultures, regulatory contexts, and customer operating models. - Embody a customer-centric philosophy focused on durable value, responsible production adoption, technical excellence, and long-term partnership. - Approach your work with humility, curiosity, a collaborative spirit, and a deep commitment to the safe and beneficial advancement of AI. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.description: As a Product Delivery Manager , reporting to the Casino Backoffice and Regulatory Requirements Department Lead , you will play a key role in translating business, compliance, and regulatory needs into clear, actionable product requirements and ensuring their successful delivery. You will work on complex internal products and services where multiple initiatives, dependencies, and changing requirements need to be managed in parallel. You will be: Defining and shaping scope for initiatives, breaking down complex requirements into clear, actionable work for the development team. Planning and coordinating delivery across multiple concurrent initiatives, balancing priorities, dependencies, capacity, and business needs. Working closely with Compliance, Product, Technical Operations and other internal stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify expectations, and identify dependencies and risks early. Translating regulatory and compliance requirements into functional and technical requirements that can be understood, implemented, and tested by the development team. Ensuring a clear understanding of the product vision, scope, priorities, and requirements within the team, enabling effective day-to-day decision-making. Creating and maintaining the product backlog , ensuring it reflects functional, regulatory, compliance, and technical needs. Ensuring requirements are clear, complete, consistent, and testable , with appropriate acceptance criteria and consideration of edge cases. Owning and maintaining the product roadmap , aligning priorities and delivery expectations with stakeholders. Defining long-term, short-term, and daily priorities , adapting them as requirements, risks, or business priorities change. Identifying and managing cross-team dependencies, risks, and potential delivery blockers , ensuring they are addressed proactively. Driving the release and maintenance lifecycle of features and services, from initial requirement clarification through delivery and go-live. Ensuring that proposed changes are evaluated from the perspectives of usability, performance, maintainability, and regulatory compliance . Handling urgent issues and unexpected requests, helping the team and stakeholders assess impact, prioritize effectively, and reach timely decisions . Monitoring delivery progress and proactively communicating status, risks, dependencies, and changes in scope or priorities to relevant stakeholders. Cooperating with other Product Delivery Managers to continuously improve delivery practices, share knowledge, and build consistency across the department. To succeed in this role, you should have: At least 3 years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, Product Delivery Manager, Business Analyst, or in a similar role in a technology environment. Experience working with complex systems, configurations, business rules, and dependencies , with the ability to understand how changes in one area can affect others. Experience working with regulatory, compliance, or other requirements-driven environments is a strong advantage. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills , with the ability to break down ambiguous or complex problems and turn them into practical solutions. A good understanding of how technical systems and integrations work , including APIs, databases, service layers, and interactions between systems. The ability to translate business and regulatory needs into clear functional requirements for technical teams. Experience with Agile methodologies , such as Scrum and Kanban. Strong prioritization and organizational skills , with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing requests simultaneously. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills , including the ability to clarify conflicting expectations and facilitate decisions. Strong English skills, both spoken and written. Strong attention to detail while maintaining the bigger-picture view of the product and delivery goals . Ability to adapt to changing requirements, and make pragmatic decisions when priorities shift. A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership, identify problems early, and drive them towards resolution .

About the Opportunity As Deputy Treasurer you will report to the Treasurer, serving as their senior counterpart and shaping and executing MoonPay's treasury strategy as the business continues to scale. You will play a critical role across regulatory expansion, liquidity and capital management, treasury reporting, and trading-related activities. This is a high-impact role requiring strong financial judgment and the ability to operate effectively in a complex, fast-moving environment. You will work across Finance and other key functions to ensure MoonPay has the liquidity, capital structure, controls, and treasury capabilities required to support its strategic ambitions and expansion into new markets. What you will do Partner closely with the Treasurer to develop and execute MoonPay's treasury strategy, translating company priorities into effective liquidity, capital, risk, and treasury plans. Lead liquidity and capital management activities, including forecasting requirements, optimizing deployment of capital, and identifying emerging constraints or opportunities. Support regulatory and geographic expansion by assessing treasury implications, capital and liquidity requirements, banking considerations, and relevant regulatory requirements (e.g., NYDFS trust company and payment stablecoin frameworks, GENIUS Act, FFIEC reporting, state money transmitter/BitLicense regimes). Oversee treasury analysis, scenario modelling, and reporting, translating liquidity, capital, and risk data into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Provide senior oversight of trading-related treasury activities, including counterparty risk assessment across OTC and exchange trading relationships, applying disciplined risk management and financial analysis to decision-making, execution, and performance. Build scalable treasury infrastructure, controls, processes, and external partnerships that enable MoonPay to operate effectively as the business grows in scale and complexity. About You You have 7+ years of experience in treasury, financial services, fintech, payments, digital assets, banking, or another highly regulated and financially complex environment, including at least 2 years of experience working with digital assets or stablecoins. You have hands-on experience with digital asset treasury operations, including stablecoin reserve management, custody and wallet considerations, and exchange or on-chain counterparty risk. You bring advanced expertise in liquidity and capital management, treasury risk management, forecasting, and scenario analysis, with experience navigating complex and high-impact decisions. You have strong knowledge of financial regulation, particularly across banking, payments, money transmission, or digital asset and stablecoin frameworks, and experience evaluating the treasury implications of regulatory or market expansion. You have demonstrated the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders while operating with significant autonomy and ambiguity, balancing competing priorities, challenging assumptions, and building scalable approaches. items.description: HR biznesa partneris Operacionālajā jomā, kas nodrošina visaptverošu personāla vadības atbalstu, stiprina organizācijas kultūru un atbalsta vadītājus efektīvu lēmumu pieņemšanā un komandu vadībā. Pienākumi: Darboties kā galvenajai HR kontaktpersonai Operacionālajās funkcijās, sniedzot praktisku atbalstu vadītājiem un veicinot efektīvu lēmumu pieņemšanu. Atbalstīt darbinieku iesaistes un organizācijas kultūras attīstības iniciatīvas. Nodrošināt kvalitatīvu darbinieka dzīves cikla procesu īstenošanu (atlase, ievadīšana darbā, attīstība, snieguma vadība, darba attiecību izbeigšana) un pilnveidot procesus. Konsultēt vadītājus darba tiesību un darba attiecību jautājumos, pārvaldīt sarežģītus gadījumus un nodrošināt atbilstību normatīvajiem aktiem. Analizēt personāla datus, identificēt riskus un sadarboties ar vadību darbaspēka plānošanā un noturēšanā. Sadarboties ar HR komandām un, pēc nepieciešamības, iesaistīties svarīgu amatu atlases procesos. Apmācīt un attīstīt vadītāju kompetences personāla vadībā un līderībā. Vadīt un koordinēt darba attiecību gadījumus, nodrošinot atbilstošu dokumentēšanu. Identificēt darba attiecību riskus un ieteikt to mazināšanas pasākumus. Piedalīties HR procesu pilnveidē un starpfunkcionālos projektos. HR Business Partner within Operations who provides comprehensive HR support, strengthens organizational culture, and enables managers to make effective decisions and lead their teams. Responsibilities: Act as the main HR point of contact for Operations, providing practical support to managers and enabling effective decision-making. Support employee engagement and organizational culture development initiatives. Ensure high-quality delivery of employee lifecycle processes (recruitment, onboarding, development, performance management, off-boarding) and drive process improvements. Advise managers on labor law and employee relations matters, manage complex cases, and ensure compliance with regulations. Analyze HR data, identify risks, and collaborate with management on workforce planning and retention. Collaborate with HR teams and support recruitment for key roles as needed. Coach and develop managers’ capabilities in people management and leadership. Lead and coordinate employee relations cases and ensure proper documentation. Identify employee relations risks and recommend mitigation actions. Contribute to continuous HR process improvement and cross-functional projects. Prasības: Augstākā izglītība personāla vadības (HR) vai līdzīgā jomā; 2–3 gadu pieredze personāla vadības vai ar darbiniekiem saistītā amatā (vēlams vadītāja pieredze); Pieredze Operacionālajā vadībā; Zināšanas par darba tirgu, darba tiesību pārzināšana; Personīgās kompetences: spēja saskatīt organizācijas kopējo ainu un saprast, kā struktūrvienība iekļaujas šajā sistēmā; spēja strādāt ar cilvēkiem un caur cilvēkiem; pašmotivācija; orientācija uz rezultātu; Teicamas latviešu un angļu valodas zināšanas mutvārdos un rakstiski darba pienākumu veikšanai -darbam ar uzņēmuma iekšējām sistēmām un ikdienas saziņai ar citiem starptautiskajiem departamentiem; Augsta līmeņa datorprasmes. Expectations: Higher education within areas of HR or similar; 2–3 years of experience in HR or people-related role (preferably managerial experience); Experience within Operations; Expertise in labor market, knowledge of labour law; Personal competencies: an ability to see The big picture of the organization and how the departmental unit fits into that structure; an ability to work with and through people; self-driven; results-oriented; Excellent spoken and written Latvian and English languages for performing job duties - working with the company's internal systems and daily communication with other international departments; Advanced computer literacy.

items.title: Sales Development - ANZ
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) based in Australia, at ElevenLabs you will play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives. We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology. In this role you will: - Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market. - Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers - Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion. - Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends. - Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop. - Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness. - Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results. REQUIREMENTS - 2-3 years outbound B2B sales experience with a track record of securing new business meetings. - Demonstrated ability to build Opportunity sized lead lists in new markets and categories - Experience with full suite of prospecting tools - Demonstrated ability to build, scale process - Demonstrated ability to nurture a team - Curiosity - asking insightful questions and developing solutions from a foundation of knowledge and insight. - Self-motivated, thriving as part of a team while possessing the ability to stay driven and proactive independently. - Effective time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage a high volume of leads. - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. #LI-remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

This is a foundational front-line leadership role within OpenAI’s enterprise GTM organization. items.title: Virtual Events Manager
items.description: Perplexity is revolutionizing how companies get work done. We are seeking a Virtual Events Manager to build the channel that shows people what our products can do and teaches them how to use them. You will develop a deep working knowledge of our products, turn that knowledge into compelling live experiences, and own the programs that convert audiences into active users and qualified pipeline. This role has two sides. You are a charismatic host and product storyteller who can command a virtual room, and you are the operator who keeps every event on the rails. You will find and prepare the right experts from across Perplexity, work with Growth to build the audience, and measure whether each program produced a real business return. If you have a passion for understanding how things work, thrive in taking something complex and making it engaging, and want to build a world-class virtual events engine from the ground up, this role is for you. RESPONSIBILITIES - Know the product cold. Develop a deeper working knowledge of our products than anyone else in events, using new features as they ship, building the workflows yourself, and staying close to the teams that built them. - Own virtual events end to end. Run the channel from program strategy and calendar planning through event briefs, speaker staffing, rehearsals, live production, follow-up, and retros. Build a reliable portfolio of onboarding programs, product launches, feature deep-dives, customer conversations, and use-case workshops. - Bring the product to life. Host, moderate, present, and demonstrate the product live with energy and clarity. Turn complex capabilities into specific, accurate stories that audiences can understand and put to work. - Find and prepare the right people. Build relationships across Product, Engineering, Research, Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Marketing to identify the strongest speakers and subject-matter experts for each program. Brief them thoroughly, sharpen their stories, and make sure they are ready to deliver. - Build the audience. Partner with Growth, Lifecycle, Social, Comms, Sales, and Customer Success on full-funnel promotion plans that drive qualified registrations. Track pacing closely, identify gaps early, and run experiments across audience, creative, channel mix, timing, and follow-up. - Turn every event into an engine. Extend the value of each program through recordings, replays, clips, FAQs, demo flows, education materials, and sales follow-up. Build formats and templates that make the next event faster and better. - Measure outcomes, not just outputs. Instrument the funnel from registration through attendance, engagement, product activation, qualified pipeline, and revenue. Track cost per registration, cost per attendee, cost per qualified attendee, sourced and influenced pipeline, and channel ROI, then use the findings to improve the portfolio. - Build the operating system. Create the intake process, master calendar, production checklists, run-of-show templates, speaker bench, readiness gates, contingency plans, scorecards, and reporting cadence required to scale the channel without lowering quality. QUALIFICATIONS - 3+ years of experience in virtual events, product marketing, customer education, demand generation, or a related role, ideally within a high-growth technology company, or work that proves the skill regardless of title. - Proven ability to learn technical products deeply and translate complex capabilities into simple, specific, and accurate live demonstrations. - A polished, credible on-camera presence, with experience hosting, interviewing, moderating, or presenting to professional audiences. - Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to find, recruit, brief, and coordinate busy experts without relying on formal authority. - Full-funnel growth fluency, including registration strategy, audience segmentation, campaign testing, conversion, and post-event nurture. - Analytical rigor, with experience defining channel metrics, working with CRM and marketing automation data, and calculating return on investment. - Excellent production judgment and attention to detail, including rehearsals, technical readiness, live moderation, and fallback planning. - High slope: you learn unfamiliar products and domains fast, and your rate of improvement is your standout trait. - Extreme comfort delivering clarity in high-velocity, ambiguous environments.

items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Payward is hiring a HR (People) M&A Lead to own the people side of our M&A activity end to end — from first-pass diligence through close and integration. Reporting directly to our CPO, this is a high-pace, high-volume seat that needs someone who thrives on fast turnarounds and incomplete information. We're looking for an in-house operator with an analyst's mindset who can use AI to move fast through messy data rooms, but whose real edge is judgment — knowing what risks matter and when to deviate. THE OPPORTUNITY - Own the people's workstream of Payward's M&A activity end to end — from first-pass diligence through close and integration. - Build and own People due diligence questionnaire (DDQ) including data requests and questions to the target, follow-ups and deeper-dive workshops. - Crunch high-volume, low-structure data rooms — employment contracts, org data, comp and equity files, policies, claims history — using AI and automation to compress review cycles. - Filter signal from noise: translate hundreds of findings into a short list of flags scored against Payward's risk tolerance, with a clear recommendation attached to each. - Lead the drafting of the people-side deal mechanics: comp modelling, equity treatment, retention and earn-out structures, and deal-specific considerations that hold up in negotiation with founders. - Sit in the room with corp dev, legal, finance and People leadership — leverage SMEs and push recommendations upward, defending them with data. - Act as People M&A program manager during integration after signing: support org design, levelling and comp harmonization, retention execution, and Day 1 people readiness. - Turn each deal into reusable infrastructure and learnings — playbooks, DDQ templates, risk scoring, and automation that make the next deal faster. WHAT YOU BRING - 8+ years across M&A people/HR diligence, integration, total rewards, or corp dev — with hands-on ownership of the people workstream on completed deals. - A track record of running multi-diligence processes in tandem, to a hard timeline: knowing what to prioritize or defer. - Strong analytical depth — comfortable modelling comp, equity, dilution, retention cost and integration spend directly, not briefing someone else to do it. - Global/cross-border deal experience with multi-jurisdiction and/or regulatory change of control employment considerations. - Demonstrated use of AI and automation to review large document volumes, with judgement about where the model's output can and cannot be trusted. - Ability to make and communicate risk calls on incomplete information, and to state a position clearly to executive stakeholders. - Credibility in founder-facing negotiation conversations on comp, equity and retention structures. - Rigorous confidentiality instincts and comfort operating on live, undisclosed transactions. - High agency in ambiguity — deals move, scope shifts, and no one hands over a finished process. NICE TO HAVES - Crypto, fintech or regulated financial services acquisition experience. - Experience integrating founder-led or early-stage teams into a larger platform. - Prior work building a diligence or integration playbook from scratch. items.title: Manager, Technical & Operational Accounting
items.description: About the Team OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission. The Technical Accounting, Accounting Policy, and Financial Reporting organization partners across Finance to assess complex corporate matters and develop well-supported U.S. GAAP conclusions. The team supports non-routine business activities requiring thoughtful technical judgment, scalable accounting policies, financial statement disclosures, processes, and controls. About the Role You will partner closely with Technical Accounting, Financial Reporting and Controllership to translate complex accounting conclusions into scalable operational procedures. You will build processes for non-standard transactions, including warrants, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, non-controlling interests, hypothetical liquidation at book value allocations, business combinations, and other complex financing, investment, and capital arrangements. You will advise stakeholders across Corporate Accounting, Financial Reporting, Treasury, Legal, Tax, Strategic Finance, FP&A, Equity, Internal Controls, valuation specialists, and external auditors. You will help resolve complex accounting questions, align leaders on material judgments and risks, and translate conclusions into audit-ready memoranda, close entries, disclosures, processes, and controls. This is a highly visible role for an accounting professional who can turn technical conclusions into practical execution, support non-routine transactions through recurring close processes, and strengthen operational accounting across Finance. In this role, you will: - Own operational accounting for complex financing, investment, equity, and capital arrangements, including classification, measurement, presentation, disclosure, and recurring close processes. - In partnership with technical accounting, lead day-one and recurring accounting for non-standard transactions, including fair-value measurements, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, warrants, noncontrolling interests, and hypothetical liquidation at book value allocations. - Perform reconciliations for assigned accounts, investigate discrepancies, and drive issues to resolution. - Support the resolution of complex accounting matters during monthly and quarterly close. Ensure conclusions are reflected in financial statement presentation, footnote disclosures, journal entries, reconciliations, ownership, and controls. - Build operational processes to assess impairment indicators and asset recoverability for goodwill, intangible assets, long-lived asset groups, equity-method investments, nonmarketable equity investments, and debt securities, as applicable. - Coordinate valuations for non-standard transactions with Technical Accounting and valuation specialists. - Lead audit support for assigned investments and other complex accounting areas. Prepare evidence-backed schedules, memoranda, reconciliations, valuation support, and financial statement tie-outs. - Analyze significant equity and other compensation awards, and partner with Equity Administration and Controllership to ensure accurate, timely accounting and booking. - Coordinate with Tax on downstream impacts without owning tax conclusions. - Partner with Financial Reporting and Internal Controls to strengthen controls, SOX/ICFR readiness, impairment monitoring, audit trails, tie-outs, and subsequent-event procedures. - Monitor emerging accounting standards and translate new guidance into policies, implementation plans, disclosures, reporting calendars, and scalable processes. - Participate in cross-functional initiatives involving accounting-policy implementation, operating-model changes, legal-entity matters, and systems or process improvements. - Develop pragmatic accounting policies, playbooks, decision frameworks, and automation that improve consistency, strengthen capability, preserve judgment, reflect economic substance, and escalate unresolved issues. You might thrive in this role if you: - Hold a CPA, CA, or equivalent accounting qualification, or bring comparable demonstrated technical-accounting expertise. - Bring 5+ years of progressive experience in technical accounting, accounting advisory, public accounting, corporate controllership, or complex financial reporting, with meaningful industry or transaction experience. - Demonstrate broad U.S. GAAP expertise across corporate accounting, financial instruments, consolidation, business combinations, equity-method investments, debt and equity securities, impairment, fair value, financial statement presentation, and complex ownership structures. - Apply relevant guidance across ASC 320, 321, 323 326, 350, 360, 470, 480, 718, 805, 810, 815, and 820; and other applicable guidance as the facts require. - Have developed or reviewed audit-ready technical memoranda, implemented conclusions in recurring operations, worked constructively with external auditors, and grounded conclusions in evidence, economic substance, and authoritative guidance. - Have experience with significant aspects of close and reporting, acquisitions or investments, complex ownership structures, consolidation, or impairment assessments. Understand how technical decisions affect journal entries, reconciliations, disclosures, and controls. - Understand how accounting policies and judgments flow into close, financial statements, disclosures, reconciliations, significant estimates, treasury activity, and external-reporting readiness. - Set priorities across consequential workstreams and raise the bar for inclusive, scalable accounting practices while protecting financial reporting integrity. - Have experience with Oracle Fusion Accounting Hub, accounting rules engines, automated subledgers, ERP implementations, or similar source-to-general-ledger systems. items.title: Field Marketing Manager
items.description: Great products grow when people experience their value firsthand. We are looking for a Field Marketing Manager to design and scale programs that turn in-person engagement into enterprise pipeline. You will manage a full range of third-party sponsorships and Perplexity-led field events that drive awareness, deepen relationships with senior buyers, and accelerate opportunities. You will join a small field marketing team as an equal partner, working together to divide the portfolio based on company priorities, capacity, geography, and each person's strengths. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the strategy and execute every detail. You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Growth, Partnerships, and Customer Success to identify the right audiences, build programs around their needs, and turn each event into measurable business impact. The ideal candidate is a field marketing generalist who is equally comfortable evaluating a sponsorship, building a regional plan, hosting an executive dinner, working a conference floor, and analyzing pipeline conversion afterward. You may bring deeper experience in sponsored events or owned programs, but you should be ready to operate across both. RESPONSIBILITIES - Co-own the field marketing strategy. Work as an equal partner on a two-person field marketing team to build the portfolio around company priorities, target accounts, sales territories, product launches, and pipeline goals. Divide and conquer across programs while maintaining shared standards, visibility, and accountability. - Turn field engagement into pipeline. Design every program around a clear audience, business objective, conversion path, and follow-up plan, from pre-event outreach through opportunity creation and deal acceleration. - Own third-party event sponsorships. Evaluate conferences and sponsorship opportunities, recommend where Perplexity should invest, negotiate and activate packages, coordinate speakers and on-site presence, and build the pre-event and post-event motion required to produce a return. - Run high-impact Perplexity events. Own executive dinners, vertical roundtables, regional roadshows, customer workshops, and hackathons that build pipeline and deepen relationships with senior buyers. - Align tightly with Sales. Partner with Account Executives, SDRs, and Sales leadership on target-account lists, meeting goals, outreach, on-site roles, hand-raiser routing, and post-event follow-up. - Represent Perplexity in the market. Lead on-site execution across conferences and owned events, including messaging, booth or venue experience, executive participation, customer meetings, and post-event conversion. - Build integrated campaigns around field moments. Work with Product Marketing, Growth, Lifecycle, Social, Comms, and Partnerships to extend events through targeted outreach, content, digital programs, and sales activation before and after each moment. - Own execution end to end. Manage agencies, vendors, venues, budgets, timelines, run-of-show, staffing, production, and contingency planning while maintaining a high bar for attendee experience. - Measure outcomes, not activity. Instrument the path from invited account through registration, attendance, meeting, opportunity, and revenue. Track cost per attendee, meetings held, target-account engagement, sourced and influenced pipeline, deal acceleration, and program ROI. - Build the field operating system. Create the planning cadence, intake process, event tiers, checklists, reporting, and retros required to scale the program and make investment decisions based on results. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of experience in field marketing and event marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. - Proven track record building and scaling a portfolio that includes third-party sponsorships, conferences, and company-led field programs, with measurable pipeline or deal-acceleration results. - A versatile, hands-on operator who can move between strategy, sponsorship evaluation, campaign planning, event production, executive management, on-site execution, and performance analysis. - Deep expertise in either third-party sponsorships or company-led field events is welcome, provided you have the range and interest to operate across both. - Strong event planning and execution skills, with experience managing both intimate executive programs and larger conferences, roadshows, or customer events. - Collaborative and low-ego, with experience working alongside a peer to divide a large portfolio, make tradeoffs, share context, and step into each other's programs when needed. - Excellent relationship builder who can engage senior executives, customers, prospects, Sales teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners with equal ease. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling event narratives, executive briefs, and field campaign plans. - Analytically rigorous, with experience setting targets, managing budgets, working with CRM data, and reporting sourced and influenced pipeline. - Highly organized, resourceful, and calm under pressure, with the judgment to solve problems quickly when plans change on site. - Willingness to travel frequently for event management and field activations.

This role blends strong product fluency, instructional design, and customer advisory. You will lead live workshops, deliver services, and design adoption interventions for audiences ranging from everyday business users to technical practitioners and executive leaders, helping customers understand not just what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them effectively in real world workflows.
