items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's services partner ecosystem is a critical channel for bringing Claude to enterprise customers worldwide. This ecosystem spans the full spectrum of services firms — from global system integrators and the world's largest consultancies, to specialist and regional SIs, to our growing cohort of AI-native boutique partners. Together, their reach, vertical depth, and delivery capacity are essential to scaling Claude's enterprise footprint. Managing this breadth well requires rigor, repeatability, and a team that can drive meaningful joint outcomes across a portfolio of partners that differ widely in scale, operating model, and maturity. We're looking for a Head of Partner Management & Ecosystem BD to lead the team of Partner Account Managers responsible for the full range of our services partnerships and to develop and execute commercial strategies for the ecosystem in partnership with Sales. You'll coach and develop a team of PAMs, shape the operating model for how we engage each segment of the ecosystem, and build the programs, playbooks, and measurement systems that let us scale with quality. You'll work closely with partnerships leadership, sales, product, and customer success to ensure our partners are equipped to win and deliver transformative AI solutions for their clients. The commercial side of this role is as important as the team-leadership side. Working hand in hand with Sales leadership, you'll define where and how partners create revenue for Anthropic — which partners we co-sell with in which accounts and industries, how partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline is built and forecast, and what a joint account plan looks like when both sides own the number. You'll develop new ways of going to market, while also managing the tri-party motion with our cloud service partners and tech company partnerships, so that a services partner, a cloud platform, and Anthropic show up to a customer as one coordinated offer rather than three separate conversations. This role sits at the intersection of team leadership, partner strategy, and operational execution. You'll stay close enough to the work to engage directly with partner leadership when it matters, while investing most of your time in making your team and the broader ecosystem more effective over time. Key responsibilities Lead, coach, and develop a team of Partner Account Managers covering Anthropic's services partners, from global SIs and consultancies through to AI-native boutique partners Set scaling across the portfolio Own the ecosystem's contribution to the revenue plan; report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, bookings, and consumption to partnerships and sales leadership Shape the operating model for each segment of the ecosystem: how PAMs plan with partners, run QBRs, forecast, track partner health, and prioritize their time across a portfolio Design engagement models that fit the partner — executive-level, multi-threaded relationships with global SIs alongside scalable, programmatic coverage for boutique and regional partners Partner with the broader SI program to adapt tier structure, benefits, and requirements to partner dynamics Build and evolve playbooks that help PAMs recruit, onboard, activate, and grow partners consistently Work Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist , GTM & Corporate - EMEA
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a member of the EMEA Talent Acquisition team focused on Corporate and Go-To-Market hiring, you will be instrumental in building and scaling Mistral's EMEA-based teams across both corporate functions and revenue-generating roles. Joining early means you'll help shape our recruitment strategy and operations, partnering closely with leaders across Corporate functions (Finance, Legal, People, Operations, Marketing, Communications) and GTM functions (Sales, Pre-Sales/Solutions, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations). Your work will directly influence Mistral's commercial and operational success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional operators who will drive Mistral's growth across the EMEA region. In this role, you'll also foster a strong candidate experience and help establish recruiting best practices as we expand across multiple EMEA markets. WHAT YOU WILL DO STAKEHOLDER PARTNERSHIP - Partner deeply with Corporate and GTM leaders — from CRO and VP Sales to Finance, Legal, and People leadership — to understand hiring needs, define role specs, and identify the right talent across multiple EMEA markets. - Own full-cycle recruitment across Corporate and GTM functions: Sales, Finance, Legal, People/HR, Marketing, and Communications roles. - Advise hiring managers on market mapping, leveling, comp positioning, and the competitive landscape for EMEA talent, accounting for local market nuances, benchmarking, and statutory differences across countries. - Translate the nuances of each role into compelling, accurate, and locally relevant candidate outreach. END-TO-END RECRUITMENT - Own the full recruiting lifecycle from sourcing to close, operating with autonomy on complex, high-volume roles across Corporate and GTM. - Source passive and active candidates across EMEA talent pools, particularly in AI/ML, open-source software, enterprise infrastructure, and regional corporate markets. - Conduct intake and calibration sessions with hiring managers to align on ideal candidate profiles and stage expectations. - Drive efficient, high-conversion pipelines and close candidates in a fiercely competitive market for senior talent across multiple geographies and languages. - Navigate cross-border hiring complexity, including relocation, remote-friendly offers, and country-specific employment frameworks. CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE & SELLING MISTRAL - Guide candidates through the hiring process with clear communication and a compelling narrative about Mistral's mission, culture, and trajectory. - Articulate Mistral's positioning in the AI landscape — frontier models, open-weight philosophy, and enterprise credibility — to differentiate us against better-known competitors. - Provide candidates with real insight into our GTM motion, corporate operations, growth plans, and the specific impact of their role. - Deliver a high-quality, respectful candidate experience at every stage, regardless of outcome. RECRUITING OPERATIONS & DATA-DRIVEN IMPROVEMENT - Develop and refine recruiting processes, tools, and documentation to improve outcomes and efficiency. - Use data to diagnose pipeline issues (e.g., drop-off at specific stages, time-to-fill by role, offer acceptance rates) and propose targeted solutions. - Build and maintain market maps, competitive intel, and talent pools for key EMEA Corporate and GTM segments. - Standardize interview rubrics, scorecards, and debrief practices across EMEA hiring teams, while respecting local market and language differences. RAISING THE BAR - Collaborate with Corporate and GTM leadership and the broader Talent team to continuously elevate our hiring standards. - Contribute to defining and evolving our EMEA talent acquisition strategy as we scale from early team to a mature, multi-region organization. - Partner on employer-brand and outbound sourcing initiatives that position Mistral as a destination for top Corporate and GTM talent in EMEA. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years of recruiting experience, including 2+ years in a startup or high-growth B2B SaaS/infrastructure company, with a focus on Corporate functions and/or Sales/GTM roles. - Demonstrated ability to independently hire across the full GTM stack — from Enterprise AE’s to GTM leadership — as well as key Corporate functions (Finance, Legal, People, Marketing, Operations). - Deep network and sourcing expertise in EMEA talent markets, particularly in AI/ML, open-source, developer tools, or enterprise software. - Track record of hiring in competitive, candidate-scarce markets where candidates have multiple offers, including cross-border and multi-language hiring. - Experience working across multiple EMEA markets and comfort with country-specific comp, benefits, and employment nuance. - Willingness to work on other roles as needs come up. - Comfort navigating ambiguity and switching between strategic planning and hands-on execution. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence peers and senior stakeholders without direct authority. - Organized, detail-oriented, and able to juggle shifting priorities across a high-volume hiring slate spanning two function families. - Professional experience with modern recruiting tools such as Ashby. - Familiarity with the AI/ML landscape and the ability to credibly discuss frontier model capabilities with technical GTM and corporate candidates. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT THE ROLE Cohere is seeking a Global Public Policy Manager to lead policy engagement on compute infrastructure, export controls, AI competitiveness, and sovereign AI strategies. Governments increasingly view AI as critical national infrastructure and are investing heavily in compute capacity, energy resources, and domestic AI ecosystems. This role will help position Cohere as a trusted partner in emerging discussions around AI infrastructure, national competitiveness, and sovereign AI deployment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Monitor and analyze developments related to AI infrastructure, data centers, energy policy, semiconductor policy, export controls, and national AI strategies. - Develop policy positions on sovereign AI, compute access, digital sovereignty, and AI competitiveness. - Support engagement with governments developing AI infrastructure investment programs and national AI initiatives. - Collaborate with commercial, product, and corporate development teams on strategic opportunities involving public-private partnerships. - Represent Cohere in policy discussions related to AI infrastructure, energy requirements, and technology competitiveness. - Produce policy analysis and thought leadership on AI infrastructure and sovereign AI trends. QUALIFICATIONS - 5–7 years of experience in public policy, technology policy, trade policy, energy policy, national security policy, or related fields. - Strong understanding of geopolitical technology issues, AI infrastructure, export controls, or digital sovereignty. - Ability to assess emerging policy developments and identify strategic business implications. - Excellent analytical and stakeholder engagement skills. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience working on semiconductors, cloud infrastructure, energy policy, telecommunications, or national competitiveness issues. - Familiarity with government AI investment programs and international technology policy. items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world’s largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized “house,” Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We’re growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is looking for a Head of University Recruiting to build our university recruiting and internship programs from the ground up. You’ll own our strategy for attracting exceptional early-career talent across engineering, product, design, and business functions — from our presence on campus through internship and full-time conversion. This is a high-ownership, highly visible role. You’ll build the systems, experiences, and team needed to make Polymarket a standout destination for exceptional early-career talent. You’ll combine strong operational rigor with creativity and cultural fluency to figure out how Polymarket should show up on campus. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own our campus recruiting strategy — build a year-round plan for target schools, hackathons, career fairs, partnerships, and other early-talent channels, including budget, staffing, travel, and ROI - Build Polymarket’s campus presence — create a distinctive, repeatable playbook for how we show up on campus, from event strategy and activations to candidate capture and follow-up - Launch and run our internship program — build a structured, high-quality experience from recruiting through onboarding, programming, manager enablement, and full-time conversion - Build the recruiting infrastructure — design scalable application, assessment, screening, and interview workflows that surface the strongest candidates and make it easy for hiring teams to engage them - Partner with senior leaders and hiring managers across engineering, product, design, legal, finance, marketing, and other functions to plan headcount, define hiring needs, and build effective early-career pipelines - Build and lead the team — hire and manage a small early-career recruiting team as the program scales, while setting the operating standards and culture for the function - Represent Polymarket externally — bring the right engineers, product leaders, designers, and business leaders into our campus strategy and build relationships with students, faculty, and university communities - Use data and judgment to iterate — measure pipeline quality, conversion, event ROI, and program performance to continuously improve our approach WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5–10+ years of experience building or scaling campus recruiting, university talent, early-career, or similarly complex talent programs - Track record of building systems and programs from the ground up — you’re as comfortable designing the infrastructure as you are executing against it - Exceptional operational rigor and project management skills, with the ability to own a large budget, coordinate many moving pieces, and move quickly - Ability to work across technical and business functions without needing to be the subject-matter expert for every role - A builder’s mindset — you thrive in ambiguity, take ownership, and aren’t afraid to experiment and iterate - Experience with hackathons, technical talent communities, or other creative university recruiting channels is a plus - Experience at a startup, high-growth technology company, or consulting/strategy environment is a plus BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. items.description: Perplexity is looking for a technical program manager to be the connective tissue between our model providers, engineering, and product teams, driving our core inference platform forward. Perplexity runs one of the highest-throughput inference stacks in the industry, serving Ask, Computer, and API traffic across a large and constantly shifting portfolio of first-party and third-party models. This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, and finance: you'll orchestrate across model providers and internal teams to keep new models and capacity moving smoothly into production, while executing the roadmap for the inference platform itself. The ideal candidate has strong technical judgment, thrives coordinating across teams and external partners with competing timelines, and is energized by building the operating model for a function that doesn't have much precedent yet. OUR MISSION Perplexity's mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating. Learn: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending. Build: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they've learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality. Integrate: they must interact with the world as it is to drive change and adoption. True leaders do not simply build something and hope. They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways. Repeat. For curious people this is a cycle that never ends. items.description: About Scale AI At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. Scale Frontier Data is the organization behind the training and evaluation data that frontier labs depend on. We build the systems, tooling, and expert workflows that turn hard human expertise into signals that models can learn from, across reasoning, coding, agentic tool use, and domain expertise. Reinforcement learning environments are now the center of gravity for that work: the difference between a model that demos well and a model that reliably completes long-horizon work is almost always the quality of the environments and reward signals it was trained against. Responsibilities As a Staff Software Engineer, RL Environments, you'll own the technical foundation for how Scale builds, runs, verifies, and delivers RL environments at scale. An RL environment is a real piece of software: a containerized world with real dependencies, real state, real tools, and a grader that has to be correct even when the agent is creative about breaking it. Building one is a full-stack engineering problem. Building thousands of them reproducibly, cheaply, with trustworthy reward signals and throughput measured in millions of rollouts is a systems problem that very few people have solved. You'll work on both. You'll design the platform: sandboxed execution, environment packaging and versioning, rollout orchestration, trajectory capture, verifier frameworks, and the authoring surfaces that let engineers and domain experts produce environments without reinventing infrastructure each time. And you'll go deep on the environments themselves by instrumenting real applications, designing task suites that expose specific capability gaps, and building graders that hold up under adversarial optimization. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll set technical direction across multiple teams, and you'll still be the person who writes the hard part. Required Qualifications 8+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals in distributed systems, system design, data structures, and algorithms. Strong Python skills and a track record of shipping production software; comfort in at least one other part of the stack (TypeScript/React, Go, Rust, or similar). Deep experience with containerization and sandboxed execution, including Docker, VMs, gVisor/Firecracker, Kubernetes, or equivalent. Experience building or operating high-throughput backend systems: orchestration, job scheduling, queuing, and large-scale data pipelines. Hands-on experience building with LLMs including agent loops, tool calling, MCP, or eval harnesses, and enough intuition about model behavior to reason about what a training signal actually teaches. Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous, undefined problems end to end and drive them to a shipped system. Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to align engineers, researchers, and non-engineering partners on a technical direction. Preferred Qualifications RL & Post-Training Direct experience building RL environments, agentic benchmarks, or eval harnesses (SWE-bench-style task suites, terminal or browser environments, tool-use benchmarks, or in-house equivalents). Familiarity with post-training methods: RLHF, RLAIF, RLVR, GRPO/PPO-family algorithms, rejection sampling, reward modeling, and the practical failure modes of each. Experience designing verifiable reward signals, and firsthand experience with reward hacking and how to defend against it. Experience with RL training or serving stacks (verl, TRL, Ray, vLLM, SGLang, or similar). Systems & Infrastructure Experience with high-scale sandbox or code-execution infrastructure, remote development environments, or CI systems. Experience with cloud-native infrastructure across AWS/GCP/Azure, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD. Strong observability instincts: tracing, structured logging, and metrics for systems whose failure modes are statistical rather than binary. Experience building internal tools that non-engineers rely on daily, especially data-dense review and annotation interfaces. Ways of Working Experience in a research-adjacent engineering role, translating research goals into production systems. Experience working directly with sophisticated external technical customers. items.title: Compensation & Total Rewards
items.location_text: United Kingdom, United States, New York, Poland, London, San Francisco, Canada
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. THE ROLE ElevenLabs is scaling globally at extraordinary speed, growing from 400 to 1,000+ by the end of 2026. We operate across 46+ countries, with a highly distributed workforce spanning researchers, engineers, GTM teams, operators, creatives, and frontier AI specialists. Compensation and total rewards are core to how we attract and retain the best builders in the world. This environment is inherently complex. Different regulatory frameworks. Different talent markets. Different role archetypes. High volatility in frontier AI compensation benchmarks. That complexity is not a constraint, it’s the challenge. We are looking for someone to own and evolve our global compensation and total rewards strategy, designing systems that are competitive in frontier AI markets, internally consistent, globally scalable, and built for long-term sustainability. You will operate as the single point of accountability for compensation architecture across the company, partnering closely with Operations, Legal and Finance. If you’re energized by solving hard global compensation problems, building clarity across diverse markets, and designing systems that scale globally without slowing the company down, this role is for you. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES COMPENSATION STRATEGY & PHILOSOPHY - Own and continuously refine ElevenLabs’ global compensation philosophy. - Ensure pay, equity, and incentives reinforce attraction, retention, and performance. - Balance market competitiveness with internal equity and financial discipline. - Serve as a trusted advisor on complex, high-impact compensation decisions. JOB ARCHITECTURE & LEVELING - Design systems that introduce rigor without slowing the company down. - Evolve our structure intentionally to match our scale: mature enough to support 46+ countries and a diverse set of roles, but not over-engineered or bureaucratic. - Drive clarity and consistency in job architecture, leveling frameworks, and compensation bands globally. EQUITY & LONG-TERM INCENTIVES - Design equity programs that reflect a core ElevenLabs belief: employees should be genuine owners in the company and invested in our long-term ambition. - Own our equity philosophy, structure, and grant strategy. - Partner with Finance and Legal on equity design, refresh cycles, and promotion grants. COMPENSATION CYCLES & GOVERNANCE - Assist annual compensation reviews end-to-end. - Design clear off-cycle governance and decision frameworks. - Build calibration rigor and tooling that scales globally. - Introduce AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to improve speed and consistency. - Act as the final escalation point for leveling and pay consistency decisions. BENEFITS & TOTAL REWARDS - Own global benefits strategy across a distributed workforce. - Balance standardisation with regional relevance. - Ensure benefits are competitive in frontier talent markets while remaining operationally scalable. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR EXPERIENCE - 5+ years in Compensation or Total Rewards, ideally in high-growth technology companies that operate across multiple countries - Ownership of equity programs - Strong track record of building compensation systems that scale - Experience designing and evolving job architectures and leveling systems - Experience operating in fast-scaling, ambiguous environments SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES - First-principles thinker: approach problems without bias - Hands-on builder: comfortable designing systems from scratch - Strong analytical skills: the ability to translate data into clear, strategic recommendations - Comfortable partnering with senior leaders and influencing decisions in complex, fast-moving environments - Excellent communication skills - High standards and high ownership We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Senior Android Engineer
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is looking for a Senior Android Engineer to help build a world-class trading app on Android. Millions of users follow markets, track positions, and make trades on their phones — and the Android experience needs to match that level of engagement. This is a high-ownership role for someone who understands what it takes to build a great trading or wagering experience on mobile: the performance requirements, the real-time data challenges, the UI patterns that make fast-moving information feel intuitive rather than overwhelming. You'll raise the bar across the Android codebase and help take a product that's already at scale to the next level. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build and own Android features spanning payments flows, real-time market data, and core UI with full accountability from design handoff through to production - Implement polished, performant interfaces with Jetpack Compose that hold up under real trading conditions and meet a high bar for feel and reliability - Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and Gradle configuration so the team can ship with confidence and without friction - Build and maintain integrations across WebSockets, gRPC, and streaming data to power the live market features traders depend on - Collaborate effectively with a distributed team, communicate clearly across time zones, and make good decisions without needing close oversight - Actively incorporate AI tools into your development workflow to move faster and maintain a high output bar - Identify gaps in Android architecture and engineering practices and surface them early, before they become problems at scale WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Strong, current experience with Kotlin — the kind where you can speak concretely to tradeoffs and have opinions - Strong, current experience building UI with Jetpack Compose in production apps - Practical experience contributing to CI/CD pipelines and managing Gradle build configuration - Solid understanding of modern Android architecture and the ability to make sound decisions across it without being hand-held - Active use of AI tools in your development workflow — not occasionally, but as a real part of how you work - (Plus) Experience integrating payments on Android - (Plus) Experience with WebSockets, gRPC, or other real-time data patterns on mobile - (Plus) Familiarity with cross-platform shared-code architectures - (Plus) iOS or Swift experience - (Plus) Background at a larger, more mature engineering organization where you saw practices evolve as the company grew BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $250,000 to $500,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We're looking for a React Native engineer to join a cross-functional Consumer pod focused on building and scaling core Krak experiences. You'll build alongside Product, Frontend and Backend Engineers in your pod, delivering seamless, performant user experiences across our Krak app, holding the features you ship to a high bar for UX, technical quality, and reliability. It's an opportunity to build high-impact, consumer-facing functionality used daily by a global user base. The opportunity - Design, develop, and maintain high-quality mobile applications using React Native and TypeScript, with a strong product focus and outcome-oriented mindset - Own the end-to-end delivery of assigned Krak features, from technical design through release and post-launch iteration, working closely with product strategy and customer needs - Build screens and components that are maintainable, performant, and resilient, applying established architecture and design patterns - Write clean, well-tested code and take an active part in code review, applying the team's engineering standards consistently - Contribute to technical design discussions within your pod, raising clear proposals and trade-offs for the work you own - Work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and the Rust backend engineers in your pod to deliver features with measurable customer value - Help improve code quality, shared components, and tooling across the Krak mobile codebase, keeping current with the React Native ecosystem What you bring - 3+ years of software development experience with a proven track record shipping large-scale, product-facing consumer mobile apps using React Native - Solid working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript; hands-on experience with APIs, mobile performance, frontend testing, and modern build pipelines - Strong product engineering mindset. Comfort working closely and iteratively with product and design teams to ship customer value - Comfort working with real-time systems (WebSockets, live updates) and building responsive, interactive experiences - Strong understanding of UI/UX best practices, empathy for the customer, and a passion for building intuitive, performant consumer experiences - Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to emerging technologies and development practices - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English Nice to haves - Familiarity with native mobile app development (iOS/Android) or micro interactions and animations in React Native - Experience in consumer payments, crypto, or fintech mobile applications - Full-stack engineering experience or demonstrated capability to flex into backend systems work. This is a significant value add for engineers on the team, especially paired with working knowledge of Rust, Go, or C++ - AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach - Experience with Next.js, WebSockets, async architectures, APIs, and microservices - Experience within a large technology organization or fast-growing startup - Contributions to open-source or the broader engineering community Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ROLE OVERVIEW: As a Business Development Representative (BDR) at Cohere, you will drive revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and nurturing high-potential leads for our enterprise AI solutions. You’ll act as the first point of contact for prospects, understanding their business needs and aligning them with Cohere’s products to solve complex challenges like natural language processing, AI integration, and scalable language models. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell cutting-edge IP, that is being newly productised, within your own book of business. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Proactively research and identify target accounts across region in industries such as finance, technology, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector, etc. using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and CRM platforms to prioritise high-fit prospects. - Conduct 40+ outbound calls and personalised emails daily to engage decision-makers (e.g., CTOs, CIOs, and Business Unit leads), focusing on understanding their pain points and demonstrating how Cohere’s AI solutions can address them. - Qualify leads using the BANT framework (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) and document interactions in Salesforce, ensuring a clean and actionable pipeline for the sales team. - Collaborate with marketing to refine messaging and campaigns based on prospect feedback, contributing to a 15%+ improvement in campaign response rates. - Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and Cohere’s product roadmap to position our solutions effectively and anticipate customer needs. - Run independent sales cycles on smaller opportunities with less overhead, from intro to close. QUALIFICATIONS: - 2+ years of experience in business development, sales, or a related role, with a proven track record of exceeding lead generation targets in a SaaS or tech environment. - Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and build rapport quickly over phone and email. - Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement platforms, with the ability to analyse data to optimize outreach strategies. - Experience in AI, machine learning, or enterprise software sales, with a basic understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts. - Closing experience is seen as an advantage. - A builder mindset is necessary to succeed here, the challenges will be unique based on the team you’ll be working with, and the role will evolve over time. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.
